name: Store Stock Checker
description: It tells you the moment an Apple product is in stock at a store. Plans are Starter $5 a month, Plus $10, and Max $20. Founded 23 October 2026 by Bryce.

mentions.evidence: MRR $17,610. 2,338 subscriptions. The last 7 days, the last 30 days, and the all-time total are the same $17,700, so all of the money arrived in the first week. Last-30-day margin 99% claimed. 2,672 visitors and 26,512 Google impressions in the last 30 days. Listed for sale at $75,000 (0.4x), 0 offers. Revenue synced 30 October 2026 ~07:55 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: An alert for one scarce thing, treated as a cash burst.

whyItPrints: It is a polling job and a notification, sold while a product is hard to find. A 99% margin means there is almost no cost. The seller listed it cheap, which reads as not expecting the spike to last.
whyThisMatters:
Store Stock Checker watches Apple stores and pings you when a product is in stock. Three plans, from a few dollars to twenty. Bryce started it on 23 October 2026.

Stripe shows a couple of thousand subscriptions, and every dollar so far landed in the first week. The last seven days, the last thirty days, and the all-time total are the same number. Margin is claimed at ninety-nine percent, which fits a notification with almost no cost. The asking price is low for that monthly line, and there are no offers. That reads as a seller who does not think the spike holds.

You pay for a ping during a shortage. The page is not treating this as a settled business.

Starter, Plus, and Max are the three plan names. Google impressions in the last thirty days are in the tens of thousands, against a couple of thousand visitors. Zero offers on a low asking price is part of the same first-week story. The founding date and the sync date are a week apart.
